properties.title: Snow Squall Warning issued November 22 at 6:40PM MST until November 22 at 7:00PM MST by NWS Missoula MT
properties.description:
At 640 PM MST, a dangerous snow squall was located 6 miles north of
Drummond, moving east at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Flash freeze on roads and rapidly falling visibility due to
intense bursts of heavy snow and gusty winds.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Travel will become difficult and potentially dangerous
within minutes.

Locations impacted include...
Drummond, New Chicago and Bearmouth.

This includes Interstate 90 between mile markers 138 and 158.
properties.instruction:
Slow Down! Rapid changes in visibility and road conditions are
expected with this dangerous snow squall. Be alert for sudden
whiteout conditions.

Wet roadways will quickly freeze. Black ice will cause roads, bridges
and overpasses to become slick and dangerous. Slow down and be
prepared for sudden loss of traction.

If traveling on a highway, find the nearest exit or rest area and
park safely away from traffic. Allow snow squalls to pass before
attempting to resume travel.

Serious injuries and deaths may result from people exiting their
vehicles during a snow squall. Drivers may not be able to see you or
stop! If you have been involved in an accident or pulled to the side
of the roadway, quickly exit your vehicle and move as far away from
the roadway as possible ONLY when it is safe to do so. Do not stand
along or near the roadway, since approaching vehicles may be unable
to maintain control.

properties.title: Special Marine Warning issued November 22 at 7:39PM CST until November 22 at 8:15PM CST by NWS Brownsville TX
properties.description:
For the following areas...
Coastal waters from Baffin Bay to Port Mansfield TX out 20 NM...

At 739 PM CST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing waterspouts
was located 23 nm south of Malaquite Beach, or 30 nm north of Laguna
Madre, moving southeast at 20 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts to nearly 50 knots.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

The severe thunderstorm will remain over mainly open waters.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

Move to safe harbor immediately as gusty winds and high waves are
expected.

Thunderstorms can produce sudden waterspouts. Waterspouts can easily
overturn boats and create locally hazardous seas. Seek safe harbor
immediately.

Frequent lightning is occurring with this storm. If caught on the
open water stay below deck if possible, keep away from ungrounded
metal objects.
properties.area: Coastal waters from Baffin Bay to Port Mansfield TX out 20 NM

properties.title: Flood Advisory issued November 22 at 5:04PM CST until November 22 at 8:00PM CST by NWS Corpus Christi TX
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...North Central Aransas County in south central Texas...
Northeastern Refugio County in south central Texas...

* WHEN...Until 800 PM CST.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 504 PM CST, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain have
fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are expected over
the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Tivoli and Austwell.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.
